words.prose: {{ar:هَلْ}} ({{tr:hal}}) opens the ayah as a proof-question: the listener is made to confirm a whole proposition, not identify an unknown word. Because the question runs through the later {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}), the surface question and the exclusive assertion stay active together; every alternative answer is already being closed off. The clause remains verbless and pronounless, so the reward relation is presented as a standing axiom rather than a dated act by a named agent. Coming after the direct dual refrain in 55:59, the particle also shifts the address into a universal test that any hearer must recognize, while its clipped sound gives the mirrored recompense formula a sharp opening.

words.prose: {{ar:جَزَآءُ}} ({{tr:jazāʾu}}) is a nominative verbal noun standing as the subject of the nominal equation, so recompense itself becomes the topic before any agent or event is named. Its construct bond with {{ar:ٱلْإِحْسَٰنِ}} ({{tr:al-iḥsāni}}) makes excellence the input whose return is being measured, and the following definite genitive gives the otherwise articleless head a specific universal scope. The root can cover reward or punishment and other settlement branches, but the local construct with excellence narrows the word to positive matched return; it is not sufficiency, fiscal payment, or a free indefinite recompense. The noun also carries a known Quranic recompense-excellence pairing, yet 55:60 compresses that formula into a verbless equation where reward is not merely declared for good-doers as in 53:31, 39:34, and 39:35, but made identical with the returned excellence. By omitting an explicit recipient after the dual address of 55:59, the recompense noun carries that audience into a universal principle.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْإِحْسَٰنِ}} ({{tr:al-iḥsāni}}) is the first excellence term, genitive because it is governed by {{ar:جَزَآءُ}} ({{tr:jazāʾu}}). Its case places it on the input side of the equation: this is the excellence being recompensed, not yet the reward predicate. The definite singular verbal noun makes the input a universal category rather than one isolated good deed, and its exact form prepares the final {{ar:ٱلْإِحْسَٰنُ}} ({{tr:al-iḥsānu}}) to return the same category with a new role. Semantically, the Form IV verbal noun names enacted excellence, doing well, beneficence, and making good; beauty language remains part of the root field and is sharpened by the garden setting, but local grammar keeps active excellence as the selected value. Against formulas that speak of best deeds or good-doers in 53:31, 29:7, 39:35, 6:84, 6:154, 12:56, 12:90, and 46:12, this first occurrence helps make the deed-quality itself the term that will be mirrored. The long matching sound of the two excellence forms lets the ear hear sameness while the case ending marks movement from deed to return, and after the favor challenge in 55:59 it supplies the positive standard that denial should have answered.

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) is the pivot where the question becomes a closed answer. In the {{ar:هَلْ}} ({{tr:hal}}) frame it does not mean a conditional unless; it excludes every recompense predicate except the following {{ar:ٱلْإِحْسَٰنُ}} ({{tr:al-iḥsānu}}). The particle has immediate scope over the nominative predicate and broader scope over the clause, so it both introduces the answer and seals the proof. Because the exception is connected, the final excellence remains inside the class of recompense as its sole remaining member, not an external add-on. Its compact doubled sound concentrates the narrowing before the final excellence opens, and its lack of a conjunction makes the second excellence the only permitted answer rather than an additional item.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْإِحْسَٰنُ}} ({{tr:al-iḥsānu}}) is the nominative predicate after {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}), so the final word supplies the restricted answer: the recompense of excellence is excellence. Its definiteness recovers the earlier {{ar:ٱلْإِحْسَٰنِ}} ({{tr:al-iḥsāni}}) as the same universal category, while the case shift changes the role from rewarded input to returned output. The predicate keeps the Form IV verbal noun abstract, not a concrete beautiful group or a label for good-doers, so the return is the act-quality of making good itself. The syntax makes this identity non-negotiable, and the final position lets the repeated excellence land as the takeaway. In the surrounding surah flow, this standalone axiom is bracketed by the refrain in 55:59 and 55:61, answers the favor-denial logic with a standard of excellence, and then lets later garden beauty language in 55:70 and 55:76 resonate without replacing the local abstract predicate.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construct 'recompense of ihsan' and the repeated definite ihsan place one quality in deed and answer positions.
baseline_models.mechanism: Recompense creates a responsive relation, while lexical repetition makes the answer resemble the initiating act in beneficent quality without collapsing their distinct roles.

activation_trace.role: Matching an act with its requital supplies the responsive relation between the two occurrences of ihsan.
Doing beautifully, benefiting another, and exceeding bare justice supplies the quality repeated on both sides.

changed_reading.before: A good deed receives a good reward.
changed_reading.after: The answer must reproduce ihsan's beneficent manner across distinct act-and-response roles, not merely carry a positive label.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exclusive question built with hal and illa surrounds jaza and the repeated ihsan.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sufficiency branch of jaza turns the question from what follows ihsan into what can adequately stand in for it; the exclusion answers that nothing except ihsan can do so.

activation_trace.role: Standing in, discharging, and sufficing makes recompense an adequate substitute rather than merely a later prize.
Beneficent action supplies the only quality capable of answering beneficent action without remainder.

changed_reading.after: Nothing alien to ihsan can adequately answer or stand in for it; only renewed ihsan discharges its claim.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Jaza is the head noun governing the first ihsan, and the second ihsan occupies the exclusive answer slot.
baseline_models.mechanism: The debt-collection branch makes prior ihsan generate answerability: its recipient is not buying the gift but is placed under a relational due whose fitting settlement is another ihsan.

activation_trace.role: Demanding or collecting a due supplies the otherwise hidden obligation carried by recompense.
Benefiting another makes the due relational and supplies beneficent action as its fitting settlement.

changed_reading.before: Reward is an optional bonus added after goodness.
changed_reading.after: Received ihsan creates answerability, and only ihsan can settle that due in kind.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The packet preserves a non-dominant mapped target for the focus token jaza alongside the dominant requital target.
baseline_models.mechanism: The split target permits a harvest-time hearing: ihsan develops to the point at which its own yield is ready to be cut or gathered, so consequence is fruition rather than an externally attached payment.

activation_trace.role: Readiness and season for shearing or harvest supply a maturation threshold within the focus token's split mapping.
Doing well supplies what is cultivated and what reappears as the mature yield.

changed_reading.before: A judge assigns goodness an equivalent reward after the act.
changed_reading.after: Ihsan ripens toward a harvest whose gathered yield is itself ihsan.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah begins with initiating mercy and repeatedly presents graces to a pair of addressees under the question of denial. The focus therefore becomes a relay: prior divine beneficence calls for answering ihsan, which is itself met by further ihsan.

activation_trace.role: Matched requital supplies the return leg of the response loop.
Benefiting and acting beautifully supplies a quality that can pass from giver to receiver and back again.
Tender mercy supplies an initiating generosity prior to any focus-ayah exchange.
Graces and favors supply the repeatedly received goods that call for a response.
Contradicting truth supplies denial as the failed response against which answering ihsan is heard.

changed_reading.before: The ayah states a symmetrical exchange between an isolated deed and reward.
changed_reading.after: The ayah is a mercy-initiated response circuit in which received ihsan solicits ihsan and returns as renewed ihsan.

context_deltas.mechanism: Balance, equity, and the ban on short measure establish a non-deficiency floor, while the focus branch of ihsan explicitly reaches beyond justice. Matching therefore governs quality and prevents shortfall without requiring a numerically closed one-for-one return.

activation_trace.role: Matching requital supplies correspondence between act and answer.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, tarihsel bir yönetim düzeninde koruma statüsü verilen inanç topluluklarından alınan belirli vergiyi açıkça tanımlar. Adın açıklaması konusunda biri yükümlülüğün ödenmesini, diğeri can güvenliği karşılığında yeterli sayılmasını öne çıkaran iki görüş bulunur; ikisi de dalın vergi kimliğini değiştirmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel vergi ya da herhangi bir pay değildir; belirli bir tarihsel koruma statüsüne bağlı mali yükümlülüktür.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan bu tarihsel vergi türünü verir ve kapsamını başka vergi, pay veya genel karşılık anlamlarıyla genişletmez.

concept_map.definition: Tarihsel bir yönetim düzeninde koruma statüsü verilen başka inanç topluluklarından alınan belirli bir vergidir. Adlandırılması, kaynaklarda ya yükümlülüğün ödenmesiyle ya da can güvenliğinin sürmesi karşılığında yeterli sayılmasıyla açıklanır.

facets.statement: Vergi, tarihsel olarak yönetim altında koruma statüsü verilen başka inanç topluluklarından alınır.
Adın gerekçesi, bir açıklamada borç sayılan yükümlülüğün ödenmesine, diğerinde can güvenliği karşılığında yeterli sayılmasına bağlanır.
Sözcüğün çoğul biçimi aynı türdeki vergileri topluca gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar verginin kimliği ve kimlerden alındığı konusunda birleşir; adlandırmayı ise yükümlülüğün ödenmesi veya can güvenliği karşılığında yeterli sayılma üzerinden iki ayrı biçimde açıklar.

concept_map.definition: Saçı, yünü, otu, ekini veya benzeri bir şeyi kırkarak ya da biçerek kesme eylemidir. Bu eyleme yarayan alet ile yünü kırkılan koyunlar, çekirdeğe bağlı adlandırmalardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dal çerçevesi, kaynak söz öbeğinin kişiyi sevindiren iyilik, bolluk, iyi karşılık ve iyi son anlamlarını doğru biçimde toplar. Sonsuz mutluluk yurdu, utkı ve inancı uğruna ölme belirli iyi sonuçlar olarak kalmalı; dalın tamamı yalnızca bu örneklere veya güzel bir niteliğe indirgenmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, bir şeyi güzel kılan niteliği ya da iyilik etme eylemini değil, kişiye ulaşan iyi şeyi, karşılığı veya sonucu bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel olarak kişiye ulaşan iyilik ve iyi sonuç bildiren tek sözcüklü biçimler ile iki iyi sonuçtan birini anlatan kalıplaşmış söz öbeği ayrı tutulmalı; bu söz öbeğinin ikili sınırı bütün dala yayılmamalıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiyi sevindiren iyilik, bolluk, iyi karşılık veya kötü bir şeyin karşısında yer alan iyi sonuçtur. Belirli kullanımlarda sonsuz mutluluk yurdu, utkı ya da inancı uğruna ölme gibi iyi sonları gösterir; iki seçenekli kalıplaşmış kullanım ise yalnızca son iki sonucu birlikte sınırlar.

facets.statement: Kişiye ulaşan ve onu sevindiren iyilik, iyi karşılık veya iyi sonuç, kötü şeyin ve kötü sonun karşıtıdır.
Bolluk, geniş geçim ve utkı, kişinin dünyadaki yaşamında karşılaştığı sevindirici iyi sonuçlar olarak bu dala girer.
İyi bir karşılık veya ödül, sonsuz mutluluk yurduyla örneklenen olumlu son biçimini alabilir.
İki iyi sonuçtan birini bildiren kalıplaşmış kullanım, seçenekleri utkı ile kişinin inancı uğruna ölmesiyle sınırlar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların toplu anlatımı, kötü şeyin karşısındaki sevindirici iyiliği hem dünyadaki bolluk ve utkı hem de ödül ve iyi son olarak verir. Sonsuz mutluluk yurdu ile iki iyi sonuçtan biri olan utkı veya inanç uğruna ölüm, genel çekirdeğin belirli gerçekleşmeleridir.
